compiled_state.description:
## Goal
Create the architectural-probe agent (or prompt template) and implement the dispatch gate that calls it when class:architectural is detected.

## Files to Create
- plugins/dso/agents/architectural-probe.md (agent: produces end-to-end test scaffold or integration-harness spec)
- plugins/dso/scripts/run-architectural-probe.sh (wrapper that invokes agent, captures output to file, checks non-empty)

## Agent Output Requirements
- Must produce at least one of: (1) end-to-end test scaffold file path + skeleton content, OR (2) integration-harness spec file path + schema content
- Output file must be non-empty to pass gate

## Acceptance Criteria
- bash tests/scripts/test-architectural-probe-gate.sh exits 0 (all 4 cases GREEN)
- grep -c 'architectural-probe' plugins/dso/scripts/run-architectural-probe.sh should be at least 1

## Testing Mode
GREEN (new agent + wrapper script; depends S5/T1)
